home.title: AccioPass — Password manager and authenticator
home.description: Keep your passwords and generate your two-step verification codes. Everything is encrypted on your device: we do not hold the key to read it.

security.title: AccioPass security: what we can and cannot see
security.description: How your vault is encrypted, what the server keeps, how recovery works and what limits the model has, explained without embellishment.

og.alt: AccioPass: your passwords and codes, encrypted on your device.

features.codes: TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard two-step verification codes
features.vault: Encrypted vault for passwords and secure notes
features.generator: Generator of passwords, passphrases and PINs
features.breach: Leaked-password check without sending the passwords
features.sharing: Sharing of encrypted items with other accounts

alt.vaultWide: Screenshot of the AccioPass web app in a wide window: the vault with seven sample items on the left and the detail of a login, with the password hidden.
alt.vault: Screenshot of the AccioPass web app: the vault with seven sample logins, the search box and the filters.
alt.addCode: Screenshot of the AccioPass web app: the screen for adding a code, with the options to scan the QR, type the key by hand or paste a link.
alt.recovery: Screenshot of the AccioPass web app: the screen of the 24 recovery words, with the words hidden and the warning that they will not be shown again.
alt.offline: Screenshot of the AccioPass web app offline: a login just added, with the notice that the change is saved on the device and waiting to be synchronised.
alt.security: Screenshot of the AccioPass web app: the security centre, with the state of the vault from 0 to 100 and the count of leaked, weak and reused passwords.
alt.share: Screenshot of the AccioPass web app: the screen for sharing an item, which explains what sharing means and asks for the e-mail of the other person.
alt.generator: Screenshot of the AccioPass web app: the generator with a random password, its estimated strength and the random, passphrase and PIN modes.
